europe_now.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz traveled to Kyiv to offer further support to Ukrainian leadership. The visit coincided with ongoing Russian aerial attacks that impacted local infrastructure.

europe_now.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina Holds General Election
europe_now.summary: Citizens in Bosnia and Herzegovina headed to the polls for a general election amidst persistent ethnic divisions and divisive political campaigns. Pro-Russian figures and regional stability remain central concerns during the vote.
